# Assumptions

| ID | Assumption | Evidence | Validation plan | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ROAM-A01 | The seven-resource Release app fits acceptable download, install, memory, and interaction budgets. | The exact-current unsigned structural archive is 270 MB with a 258 MB uncompressed app, and local deterministic operations have non-gating baselines; no owner budget, App Store thinned size, or exact-device performance/energy result exists. | TF-011 owner budget approval plus exact seven-resource App Store/device size, memory, interaction, and energy measurement. | open |
| ROAM-A02 | Users understand “ZIP Code Area” with concise ZCTA disclosure. | Current onboarding is clear in simulator audit. | Uncoached beta comprehension test. | open |
| ROAM-A03 | iOS background updates are sufficient to capture meaningful boundary crossings. | Core Location implementation exists. | Multi-device physical route test. | open |
| ROAM-A04 | Four simplification levels are worth their storage cost. | Existing overlay resolver consumes four levels. | Compare size/frame-time with fewer levels. | open |
| ROAM-A05 | App Privacy can truthfully report no developer data collection. | Roam is local-first and has no app backend; MapKit and StoreKit provide Apple services. | TF-005 binary/SDK/network inventory and App Privacy review. | open |
| ROAM-A06 | The final binary remains exempt from encryption documentation with `ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false`. | Current Info.plist declares false; no custom encryption was identified. | TF-005 final binary/export-compliance review. | open |
| ROAM-A07 | Team `796XH483R4` can create or use an explicit App ID, app record, and distribution profile for `com.localfirst.roam`. | Development signing exists, but distribution export currently fails. | TF-001 Apple account verification. | open |
| ROAM-A08 | The owner intends Roam Plus to ship in the first beta and has commercial agreements/tax/banking available. | StoreKit code/config exists; App Store Connect product and agreement state are unverified. | TF-006 owner decision and ASC verification. | open |
| ROAM-A09 | iOS 17.0 is the intended minimum for the beta audience and can be exercised on physical hardware. | Project setting is iOS 17.0. | TF-007 audience approval and TF-008/010 device matrix. | open |
| ROAM-A10 | The 69,542-city GeoNames `cities5000` catalog is a useful first-slice balance between worldwide recall, offline search quality, and app size. | The deterministic artifact contains 69,542 city points and 250 addable current countries with verified points in 52,236,288 bytes; no uncoached product test or thinned-size/device search measurement exists. | Uncoached WP-004 browse/search tasks and TF-011 seven-resource size/search measurement; add telemetry only if later privacy-approved. | open |
| ROAM-A11 | People prefer browse-first one-tap unknown-date entry over typing full locations and exact dates. | Owner feedback explicitly rejects location/date typing as the primary path; no broader usability study exists. | WP-004 prototype/device study measuring successful country/city batch entry without coaching. | open |
| ROAM-A12 | Natural Earth coarse country geometry can truthfully highlight most manually added countries while omitted/small territories use markers. | The current 1:110m bundle has 177 features and the 250-current-country catalog has 175 verified polygon crosswalks plus 75 marker-only countries; omission and coarse-island behavior are known. | Manually inspect missing/ambiguous territories and the outline-unavailable fallback on the exact candidate before FEAT-005 approval. | open |
| ROAM-A13 | A static per-country artifact channel can be approved later without creating a user-data backend. | DEC-004 currently permits bundled local data only; no hosting, integrity, retention, or policy decision exists. | WP-007 architecture/legal/product review before implementing downloads. | open |
| ROAM-A14 | A local-first trip planner built around offline destination selection plus explicit online POI/routes is useful without accounts, collaboration, reservations, or a backend. | The owner requested Madrid-area suggestions and walking tours, but no prototype or uncoached study exists. | Build only after FEAT-006 promotion; test Madrid plan creation, itinerary assembly, walking-plan comprehension, and offline recovery without coaching. | open |
| ROAM-A15 | Users will understand planned, remembered, and observed map states when their color, icon, label, and actions differ. | DEC-012 defines the semantic split; no visual/accessibility study exists. | TRIP-004/TRIP-009 automated semantics plus VoiceOver and uncoached device testing; reject any design that makes a plan appear visited. | open |
| ROAM-A16 | Ordered processing plus bounded same-area and diagnostic checkpoints can materially reduce saves without losing visit transitions or an unacceptable amount of last-seen progress. | Current code normally saves once per processed sample with diagnostics enabled; no approved cadence or loss budget exists. | TF-008.8 baseline, owner-approved checkpoint/loss budgets, TF-008.10/.11 deterministic failure/relaunch tests, and physical route comparison. | open |
| ROAM-A17 | A private lifecycle—past history, future plans, during-trip suggestions, then optional memories—will be more useful than adding an undifferentiated social feed first. | Owner feedback requests trip planning, tours, photos, steps, check-ins, and social potential; no cohort evidence ranks them. | Execute Phases 0–2, use TF-013.8/TF-014 beta evidence and uncoached studies, then record promotion decisions; SOC-001 separately validates network social. | open |
